notes: "Three pieces of software are involved, and it helps to keep them apart. The Editor is the desktop application. Besides the canvas, it runs the local document service, and that service is the only thing that writes the project files. The plugin is what an agent loads: a skill plus a Story guide and an operations guide, so the agent knows to read context first, preview, apply and verify. The connector is the link between an agent and the Editor that is already open. The Editor's Agent setup panel generates the configuration for each client; generating it does not install or connect anything by itself. There is deliberately no chat box inside the Editor. You keep using the agent you already use."

designIntent.purpose: Separate the roles of Editor, plugin and connector in audience language.
keep: Describe ChatGPT only as connecting to the local Editor; no internal connection brand names
